BiblicalUsage: Pachaz occurs once, in Jacob's blessing, where Reuben is called unstable as water because he went up to his father's bed and defiled it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe one word can carry a life's warning: Reuben was the firstborn, but recklessness cost him the excellency of his birthright.
